title: `core::io::RawOsError` should probably be an `i16` on AVR and MSP430
author: tgross35
body_preview: `RawOsError` is usually the side of an `int`, except on UEFI where it is a `usize`. On everything in `std` `int` was an `i32`, but on 16-bit AVR and MSP430, it's an `i16`.
